d: Sgt. Carter learns Bunny was seen with another man.
Gomer can predict the weather better than the weather bureau.
A songstress applauds Gomer's song with a kiss.
Gomer unwittingly signs up a fugitive bank robber as a new recruit.
Toody is pickpocketed by a professional pickpocket, and the thief steals Toody's identity as a police officer.

st: The Beast Who Walked the Bronx
d: The inspector tells Block to take a vacation and one of the officers at the precinct is named his temporary replacement.
While attending a wedding, Sylvia and Leo are married by a Justice of the Peace. Afterward, Sylvia sets out to correct the mistake.
The officers debate what to get Block for his anniversary.
Betty Jo has her first crush - but the object of her affections (Orville Miggs) is more interested in tinkering with cars than he is in romance.

st: Behind All Silver, There's A Cloud Lining
d: Uncle Joe tries to bring more guests to Shady Rest--and get his drainage ditch dug for free--by spreading rumors about a silver strike in the area.
Uncle Joe is promoting a talent contest, and he tries to make sure that one of his three nieces wins.
An old school chum thinks it's time Kate was married again, and she tells the girls to round up some prospects.
Uncle Joe decides to bankrupt the Hooterville Cannonball by starting his own railroad, powered by Orville Miggs' flivver.
Homer Bedloe becomes superintendent of the Hooterville Cannonball. He forces Charley & Floyd to keep to a strict schedule, all in his latest attempt to shut the train line down.
After Steve starts dating a wealthy businesswoman, he becomes increasingly uncomfortable with her generous gifts and extravagant lifestyle.
When Robbie saves a girl from being hit by a car, she tells him that she owes him her life... literally!
Robbie helps a stranded woman after her car runs out of gas but when she comes to the Douglas house to repay him, the family discovers that she's a famous African explorer!
Robbie is accepted to college and wants to live in the dorms despite the family living five minutes from campus. But living alone is more lonely than Robbie expected.
Steve is surprised and uncomfortable when Chip refuses to get his long hair cut.
Robbie falls in love and plans to get married after college. But when they have to babysit a friend's child on short notice, they realize that they are far too young to be married.

st: The Secret Life Of Gomer Pyle
d: Carter suspects Gomer has been spending his Sundays at the beach; then tries to meet the beauties Gomer appeared with in a magazine.
Carter tries to transfer Gomer to the Marine band.
Gomer holds a farewell dinner in a Chinese restaurant, not knowing it is a front for a gambling operation.
Two shyster lawyers try to get Gomer and Carter to file a false damage suit after a near miss from an automobile.
Toody's nephew helps him and Muldoon solve previously unsolvable cases. But before they realize Marvin's worth, the others find out about him.
It's the day of the annual policeman's ball, and Toody makes an unforgettable entrance.
Toody and Muldoon are assigned to pick up the President of the United States from Idlewild Airport and drive him to the United Nations.
Muldoon moves in with Toody and his family, but when odd things happen while everyone's sleeping, Muldoon and Lucille think they've having an affair with each other.
